operation_details.item: The user has a latex allergy and must avoid latex gloves and latex-containing lab equipment.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: As a research professional, are there any specific health concerns you have regarding lab work?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I have a latex allergy; using latex gloves in the lab or handling latex-containing equipment causes skin irritation and respiratory symptoms.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's important to note. Since you're in a research environment, you should avoid latex gloves. Nitrile gloves are a common alternative. Also, check labels on all equipment for latex content.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thank you. I'll make sure to order nitrile gloves for my upcoming experiment.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good. Also, if you encounter any latex-containing equipment, consider using vinyl or neoprene alternatives, or apply barrier protection.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I'll review the lab inventory for any latex items.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's a proactive step. Do you have a specific experiment in mind?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I'm setting up a wet lab experiment and need protective gloves. What should I use?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For a wet lab, nitrile gloves are ideal as they are resistant to many chemicals and are latex-free. Always double-check the label to ensure they are marked as latex-free.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Perfect. I'll ensure my lab has those in stock.
